Arachnid hives are expanding in the treacherous volcanic mountains, launching relentless attacks against nearby industrial facilities.

To deal with this escalating threat, Mobile Infantry must team up with Hephaestar's contractors.

column2: An alarming surge in Arachnid activity has been detected in this sector, posing a direct threat to Hephaestar's assets and personnel.
A detachment of the Mobile Infantry has been rushed in to reinforce the corporation's security contractors and wipe out the infestation.
Once again, the brave men and women of the Mobile Infantry have successfully driven back the vicious Arachnids.
Hephaestar’s security contractors have proven to be an unreliable partner. Their inability to support the Mobile Infantry has forced a premature termination of the mission.
